paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: The evaluation of inference methods using an A100 80GB GPU on LLaMA 2-13B and 70B. Length: prefill length + generation length. Bsz: batch size. KV mem.: GPU memory usage (GB) of the KV cache. Thr.: throughput (token/s) : S_r ratio ablation study.
model_annotation:
The plot illustrates the relationship between the recent sequence ratio and various performance metrics. 
The x-axis represents the recent sequence ratio as a percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 0% to 100%, marked with tick labels at regular intervals of 20%. 
The y-axis on the left side represents perplexity, with a linear scale ranging from 4.2 to 4.7, and the y-axis on the right side represents the GPU memory ratio as a percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 40% to 100%. 
The plot contains four lines: an orange solid line with circle markers representing perplexity starts at approximately (0, 4.65) and decreases to approximately (100, 4.3); a red dashed line representing full cache PPL is constant at approximately 4.4; a blue solid line with circle markers representing GPU memory ratio starts at approximately (0, 4.25) and increases to approximately (100, 100); a maroon dashed line representing full cache GPU memory is constant at approximately 60.
